claim: shadcn/ui documents React Hook Form, TanStack Form and Formisch as first-class form paths, with React useActionState listed as coming soon.
quote: React Hook Form / TanStack Form / Formisch ... React useActionState (Coming Soon)

claim: shadcn moved away from the RHF-coupled <Form> wrapper to the library-agnostic <Field> family (Oct 2025) for transparency, portability and multi-engine support; <Form> still exists as a thin RHF wrapper.
quote: <Field> is a form-library-agnostic layout primitive handling labels, descriptions, errors, and orientation. It works with React Hook Form, TanStack Form, Server Actions, and custom form solutions.

claim: Base UI ships first-party integration recipes for React Hook Form (<Controller> forwarding field/fieldState, inputRef for focus) and TanStack Form (<form.Field> children with field.state.value / handleChange / handleBlur).
quote: Use the <Controller> component to integrate with any <Field> component, forwarding the name, field, and fieldState render props

claim: React Aria builds on native HTML constraint validation with validationBehavior native|aria, FieldError, and server errors via Form validationErrors (Zod flatten().fieldErrors, useActionState); docs say uncontrolled + built-in validation suffices for most forms.
quote: In most cases, uncontrolled forms with the builtin validation features are sufficient.

claim: Mantine ships its own form engine, @mantine/form, whose getInputProps output is compatible with all Mantine inputs (@mantine/core, @mantine/dates) out of the box.
quote: @mantine/form package contains useForm hook ... all Mantine inputs are compatible with useForm out of the box

claim: Binding MUI X DatePicker to RHF Controller requires routing field.ref to the picker's inputRef separately; otherwise validation focus and keyboard/mask handling break.
quote: separate the ref from the other field props and pass it to DatePicker's inputRef prop instead

claim: shadcn + TanStack Form binds controlled components via field.state.value / field.handleChange / field.handleBlur, with data-invalid and aria-invalid wired by hand.
quote: <Select value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange}> ... Pass aria-invalid={isInvalid} to controls

claim: TanStack Form's UI-libraries guide states there is no universal adapter: event payload extraction differs per kit (MUI/Mantine e.target.value, shadcn onCheckedChange, Chakra !!details.checked).
quote: selective approach is due to the slight differences in types between components and the field

claim: Base UI Field validates against native HTML5 constraints (valueMissing, rangeUnderflow...), supports validationMode onSubmit/onBlur/onChange, validationDebounceTime, and a custom validate function.
quote: The Field component supports three validation modes: onSubmit, onBlur, onChange ... automatically validates based on native HTML5 constraints

claim: Community criticism of @mantine/form vs RHF: whole-form re-render on every input change and field names not type-enforced in setFieldValue/getInputProps.
quote: entire form re-rendering on every input change ... TypeScript types for field names not enforced on setFieldValue and getInputProps parameters

claim: Mantine spells out the custom-input contract for getInputProps: value, defaultValue, onChange, error, onBlur.
quote: Custom inputs must accept value, defaultValue, onChange, error and onBlur props
